rules.statement: The claim for a conveyance under the terms of P1 was not prescribed as prescription began to run from the date on which the demand for the conveyance was refused.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held , that prescription commenced to run against the plaintiff from the date on which his demand for a conveyance was refused. Ismail v. Ismail (22 N. L. R. 476 ) followed."
